svg.title: A trading range and the events that mark its phases
svg.desc: Line chart with 40 points from 0 to 39. Price: opened at 78.00 on 0 and closed at 76.83 on 39, a change of −1.17 (−1.5%); high 78.39 on 2, low 70.23 on 17. Reference lines: Preliminary support at 12; Selling climax at 14; Automatic rally at 16; Secondary test at 18; Spring at 27; Sign of strength at 30; Top of the range at 72.70; Bottom of the range at 70.23. Zones: Range, 14 to 29.
svg.text: A trading range and the events that mark its phases
